```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(broom)
```

```{r fit-models}
data("diamonds", package = "ggplot2")
mod1 <- lm(log(price) ~ log(carat),                      data = diamonds)
mod2 <- lm(log(price) ~ log(carat) + cut + color + clarity, data = diamonds)
```
